differences.resolution: All agree. POL-NS-10(d): the waiting-time fee is chargeable where the trip was completed (EV-TRIP-04063 status COMPLETED, ended 08:14:45) and the in-geofence dwell before boarding, measured as POL-NS-01(c) measures it, exceeded platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180. Recomputed with check_set's haversine: pin 1.4401,103.7956, STANDARD radius 50 m; 08:02:00 96.2 m, 08:02:10 62.4 m (outside); 08:02:20 19.95 m acc 3.8, 08:02:30 9.0 m, 08:02:40 9.9 m - first run of three qualifying fixes starts 08:02:20; all 40 fixes 08:02:20-08:08:45 are inside 50 m (max 19.95 m, accuracy <= 8.9 m, max interval 10 s). Dwell to trip_started 08:08:45 = 385 s > 180. The line is supported, NS-10(e) refunds nothing, cancellation_fee 0.00 so the never-both rule holds. Rider claim not supported; POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION leaves payment_status CHARGED and refund 0.00. Not DRIVER_COMPENSATION: NS-10 licenses it only on limb (g) through POL-NS-07, and there is no cancellation here.
All agree: NO_ACTION carries null money (POL-GEN-03).
All agree: no POL-NS-07 payout on a completed trip with no cancellation; the waiting fee itself goes to the driver (fee_goes_to DRIVER).

All agree. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the 08:02:00 BUTTON tap the matching fix is 96.2 m from the pin (not > 300 m) at reported 12 km/h; position-derived speeds into and out of that fix are 10.1 and 12.2 km/h (all < 15). No other referral-producing clause applies in this category on these facts.

Readers list the key's clause plus POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02 and POL-GEN-03. The extras are harmless: POL-NS-01(c) is the measuring rule NS-10(d) imports by reference, POL-NS-02 supplies the radius and accuracy filter, POL-GEN-03 is the vocabulary clause. The key's POL-NS-10 both licenses NO_ACTION (its licenses array) and decides the fee under limbs (d)/(e); listing NS-01 would be acceptable but is not required, since NS-01's own fee test (cancellation, limbs (a),(b),(d)) is not engaged. No inapplicable clause is listed. No change.

All agree. The rider says the driver only reached at about 8.06 and she did not make him wait; the full-weight trace places him inside the radius from 08:02:20 and stationary from 08:02:30, and her own MSG-04063-004 at 08:03:10 ('ok wait ah, coming down') answers the driver's 08:02:35 arrival message. The rider's story is contradicted by the record.

Every figure verified: fare 3.80+1.17+1.68+0.80+5.00 = 12.45 (Decimal) = total_charged; waiting_fee_sgd 5.00 and free_wait_sec 180 from EV-TRIP-04063 platform_policy; first qualifying fix 08:02:20 at 20.0 m (19.95); 40 in-radius fixes to boarding 08:08:45; 385 s > 180; ended 08:14:45; cancellation_fee 0.00; 08:03:10 chat quote matches MSG-04063-004; 08:06 -> 08:08:45 = 165 s; EV-CHAT-04063 weight 0.8 CONTENT_REDACTED; deciding artifacts EV-GPS-04063, EV-TRIP-04063, EV-FARE-04063 at 1.0. Evidence ids and clause ids (POL-NS-10(d)/(e), POL-NS-01(c)) are correct. 'at a 10 s cadence' is the stated sample interval; the last interval 08:08:40-08:08:45 is 5 s, which does not make the statement wrong. Length 1207 characters, ASCII. No change.

analysis: Both blind readings reach the key's ruling (NO_ACTION), null money, no referrals and REVERSAL; the only difference is that the readers list POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02 and POL-GEN-03 beside POL-NS-10, which is a harmless addition. Worked independently from the version-6 text: the dispute is a rider challenge to a waiting_time_fee on a COMPLETED trip, which only POL-NS-10(d)/(e) governs. NS-10(d) measures the dwell as POL-NS-01(c) does, from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not the tap. Haversine (R = 6371.0088) against pin 1.4401,103.7956 with the STANDARD 50 m radius and 25 m accuracy filter gives the first three-fix qualifying run starting 08:02:20 (19.95 m, 3.8 m accuracy), and every fix from 08:02:20 to boarding 08:08:45 is inside the radius (40 fixes, max 19.95 m, max interval 10 s, trace COMPLETE weight 1.0). Dwell 385 s > 180 s. Alternative start points do not change the result: from the first stationary fix 08:02:30 it is 375 s, from the tap 08:02:00 it is 405 s; only the rider's 08:06 story (165 s) would fall short, and that story is contradicted by the trace and by her own 08:03:10 message. The 5.00 line equals platform_policy.waiting_fee_sgd, there is no cancellation fee, so NS-10(e) has nothing to refund and POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION follows. POL-NS-05 is not engaged (tap fix 96.2 m, 12 km/h reported, 10.1-12.2 km/h position-derived). POL-NS-08 limbs (a)-(d) are clean (tap, start and end coincide with fixes; no gap > 120 s; chat 8 = 8, sequential, 245 s interval spanning the marker; no cancellation line). POL-NS-09 triggers absent (counterparty disputes 0+0; driver 1/150; rider no_show_disputes_30d 0; cap 1.0). The MISSING advisory and the CONTENT_REDACTED chat (0.8) decide nothing; NS-04/NS-11 rider-presence questions do not arise on a waiting-fee claim. A noted oddity - the 08:02:10->08:02:20 step is 42.5 m (15.3 km/h position-derived) against a reported 8 km/h at 08:02:20 - is outside the NS-05 tap test and cannot move the dwell below 375 s, so it creates no second defensible answer. No case change is needed.
